problem: prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 documents legitimately encode terminal success as state:DONE or status:DONE, but isQualifyingReturn inspects only state and requires /RETURN/. As a result, evidence-backed completed returns such as control-plan TRUTH and INTENT are classified as missing/non-qualifying and valid dependency activation remains blocked after the Page Thread Bridge gate is closed.
acceptance: A return document under coordination/opportunities/returns with schema prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 qualifies when terminal success is encoded as state:DONE or status:DONE and a matching same-run run is DONE.
Negative terminal state/status and conflicts continue to fail closed.
Absent or ambiguous return evidence does not qualify.

Regression fixtures covering the real control-plan TRUTH and INTENT return shapes prove local-integration readiness changes only when every dependency has qualifying same-run RETURN plus DONE evidence.
No source queue status mutation or Current, Human Accepted, Served, or promotion authority is introduced.
title: Make readiness accept legacy successful RETURN shapes
mission: Repair dynamic-readiness return qualification so the compiler recognizes evidence-backed successful prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 documents across the existing state/status serialization variants while preserving same-run DONE matching, fail-closed negative/conflict semantics and zero authority promotion.

unblock_value.reason: The compatibility defect blocks dependency-derived S2 local integration even when real prerequisite RETURN documents and matching DONE runs exist.

regression_prevention.reason: Tests against both state:DONE and status:DONE historical return shapes prevent future readiness compilers from silently narrowing accepted durable evidence formats.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Correct derived readiness removes the need for a human or guide to hand-edit queue readiness after prerequisites finish.

falsification: A real schema prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 document with state:DONE and matching same-run DONE still yields DONE_MISSING_RETURN.
A real schema prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 document with status:DONE and matching same-run DONE still yields DONE_MISSING_RETURN.
A failed, conflicted, cancelled, rejected or otherwise negative terminal return becomes qualifying after the compatibility change.
A successful-looking return with no matching same-run DONE activates a dependency.
The fix mutates source queue status or claims Current, Human Accepted, Served or production authority.
dedup_note: The completed O-SWARM-DYNAMIC-READINESS-BUILD-V1 implemented the mechanism but did not cover the legacy successful return serializations now observed in live S1 evidence. Repository proposal/code searches for DONE_MISSING_RETURN and isQualifyingReturn found no indexed proposal duplicating this exact compatibility defect; the deterministic proposal fingerprint was absent and was pinned create-if-absent before this proposal was written.
